name: ps2-party-pad
description: PS2 Party Pad server — phone controllers over WebSocket to virtual gamepads

scripts.check: python -m py_compile server/main.py server/net_utils.py server/rooms.py server/gamepad.py server/protocol.py server/validate.py server/config.py && node --check web/controller/controller.js && node --check web/host/host.js && python -m pytest tests/ -q
scripts.postinstall: echo "PS2 Party Pad ready. Use: npm start (server) | npm test (tests) | npm run fake:short (test clients)"
